catalog.title: Saki: Quest for Redemption
catalog.description: A private five-act arc through consultations, tribunals, and unsolicited grand gestures.
catalog.contentNotice: Absurdist bureaucratic romance-comedy framing, self-deprecating humor, and unsolicited gestures made without the other party's consent.

strings.saki.achievement_alan_watts.description: Win the argument and lose the point.
strings.saki.achievement_alan_watts.name: Alan Watts Cannot Help You Here
strings.saki.achievement_architecture_zero.descr: Build six units of infrastructure for a conversation.
strings.saki.achievement_architecture_zero.name: Architecture: 0
Ignore the correct advice four separate times.
strings.saki.achievement_content_pipeline.descri: Convert your friend's objection into the next story arc.
strings.saki.achievement_content_pipeline.name: Content Pipeline
strings.saki.achievement_dignity_underflow.descr: Reduce Lucifer's dignity to nothing at all.
strings.saki.achievement_dignity_underflow.name: Dignity: Underflow
strings.saki.achievement_full_bench.description: Consult every authority except the one that matters.
strings.saki.achievement_full_bench.name: The Full Bench
strings.saki.achievement_load_bearing_marble.des: Commission a statue of a man who did not ask for one.
strings.saki.achievement_lost_control_of_the_sco: Replace an apology with an interactive campaign.
We Have Lost Control of the Scope
strings.saki.achievement_no_consent_field.descri: Ask the one question the schema cannot answer.
strings.saki.achievement_no_consent_field.name: The Data Contract Has No Consent Field
strings.saki.achievement_normal_human_being.desc: Write the story he actually asked for.
strings.saki.achievement_normal_human_being.name: Normal Human Being
strings.saki.achievement_procedurally_insufficie: Reach the fifth act without producing an apology.
strings.saki.achievement_read_the_changelog.desc: Find the commit that predates the decision to write it.
strings.saki.achievement_read_the_changelog.name: Who Reads The Changelog
strings.saki.achievement_redeemed.description: Be forgiven for a thing that may not have happened.
strings.saki.achievement_redeemed.name: Redeemed
strings.saki.achievement_scope_creep.description: Answer an emotional problem with three repositories.
strings.saki.achievement_scope_creep.name: Scope Creep
strings.saki.achievement_seen_by_nobody.descript: Ship a private campaign to an audience of zero.
strings.saki.achievement_seen_by_nobody.name: Seen By Nobody
strings.saki.achievement_speedrun.description: Resolve the entire campaign by behaving like an adult.
strings.saki.achievement_speedrun.name: Speedrun
strings.saki.achievement_you_are_an_idiot.descri: Receive the smallest possible reaction to the largest possible gesture.
strings.saki.achievement_you_are_an_idiot.name: You Are An Idiot
strings.saki.act2_open.text:
ACT II — THE TRIBUNAL

Redemption, it turns out, has requirements. Lucifer does not know what they are.

He therefore convenes a tribunal, which is what a person does instead of asking.
strings.saki.act4_open.text:
ACT IV — THE ARITHMETIC

The narrator would like to raise something.
strings.saki.act5_open.text:
ACT V — SAKI

Saki wakes up. It is an ordinary morning.

It will remain an ordinary morning for approximately four more minutes.
strings.saki.agent_short.text:
The shortest possible version is: 'Sorry, that got a bit much. Drink sometime?'

Lucifer thanks the agent, saves the suggestion somewhere safe, and opens the campaign file.
strings.saki.apology_campaign_node.apology_campa: Continue, because stopping now would waste the work
strings.saki.apology_campaign_node.text:
ACHIEVEMENT UNLOCKED — We Have Lost Control of the Scope

The apology is now a playable adventure with branching paths, achievements and a deterministic state machine. It is, objectively, quite good.

That is not a defense. That is an aggravating factor.
strings.saki.apology_result.text:
The apology is filed.

Filed. A word that should never appear anywhere near an apology, and which has now appeared twice.
strings.saki.campaign.description: Lucifer asked a friend for a story, did not get one fast enough, and built an entire deterministic adventure game about it in roughly a day. Saki did not request this. Saki did not request any of this.
strings.saki.campaign.title: Saki: Quest for Redemption
strings.saki.changelog.changelog_next: Return to the conversation and pretend you saw nothing
strings.saki.changelog.text:
The changelog reads: 'Saki: Quest for Redemption — initial commit.' It is timestamped roughly one day after the conversation that caused it.

You have not written any of this yet. The tooling is simply confident.
strings.saki.common_sense_1.decline_philosophy: Decline: the nature of apology must first be established
strings.saki.common_sense_1.decline_scaffolded: Decline: the quest is already scaffolded
strings.saki.common_sense_1.text:
Common Sense has one recommendation. It has had the same recommendation since the beginning and will not be developing a second one.

'Just talk to Saki.'
strings.saki.consent_field.consent_field_next: Return to the tribunal, mildly haunted
strings.saki.consent_field.text:
Saki had not agreed to become an NPC. Unfortunately, the data contract contains no consent field.

The Bureaucrat suggests adding one in a future version. Lucifer writes this down. Lucifer will not do it.
strings.saki.ending_content_pipeline.text:
The Content Pipeline

Saki raises exactly one objection.

It is a good objection. It is also, Lucifer notices, a premise.

The new file is open before the sentence finishes. Somewhere a consent field is still not being added.
strings.saki.ending_idiot.text:
The Smallest Possible Reaction

Saki looks at the completed Quest for Redemption. The trials. The branching narrative. The deterministic state machine. The automated deployment pipeline. The philosophical implications.

He considers all of it for a moment, and delivers a verdict of two words that deflates the entire cosmic apparatus.

REDEMPTION ACHIEVED.
strings.saki.ending_normal_adult.text:
The Story He Asked For

You write Saki the story. No engine. No schema. No achievements. No validation gate.

It takes an evening. He reads it, likes it, and says so, and that is the entire transaction.

The infrastructure sits in the dark, unused, waiting for the next perfectly ordinary conversation.
strings.saki.ending_philosophical.text:
Philosophical Victory

Lucifer establishes, to his own complete satisfaction, that redemption is a social construct, that the self is a rumour, and that forgiveness cannot be transferred between two things that were never separate.

Saki, who has been awake for eleven minutes and has not had coffee, is unimpressed.

Alan Watts cannot help you here.
strings.saki.ending_redeemed.text:
Redemption

Saki accepts the ridiculous gesture in the spirit it was ridiculously offered.

He does not pretend it was proportionate. He does not pretend it was necessary. He reads the whole thing, finds two typos and one joke he genuinely likes, and says so.

The offense, which never existed, is formally closed.
strings.saki.ending_scope_creep.text:
Infrastructure

Rather than resolve anything emotionally, Lucifer resolves it architecturally.

Three new repositories now exist. There is a roadmap. There is a versioning policy. There is a plan to open-source the tooling that generates apologies.

Saki remains unresolved. Saki was never the blocker.
strings.saki.ending_speedrun.text:
Normal Human Being

You talked to your friend. It took four minutes and resolved everything.

The narrator, who had prepared five acts, would like it noted that this was technically the correct decision and that he is nevertheless deeply disappointed.

No repositories were created. Nobody is happy about this except the two people involved.
strings.saki.ending_unresolved.text:
Unresolved

You close the laptop without sending anything.

The campaign is complete, validated, tested, and seen by nobody. It will sit in a private repository being technically excellent.

Saki has a perfectly nice day and never learns any of this happened.
strings.saki.gift_result.text: The gift is prepared. It waits by the door with the calm of an object that does not know what it is part of.
strings.saki.gift_statue.gift_statue_next: Cancel the statue and never mention it again
strings.saki.gift_statue.text:
The statue is commissioned before anyone can intervene. It is three metres tall and depicts Saki looking mildly inconvenienced, which is at least accurate.

It will not fit through the door. Neither will the apology.
strings.saki.incident_1.incident_ask: Ask Saki whether anything is actually wrong
strings.saki.incident_1.incident_assume: Assume the worst and proceed with dignity
strings.saki.incident_1.text:
ACT I — THE INCIDENT

Something, at some point in that conversation, went sufficiently wrong that redemption is now required.

Nobody has confirmed this. Saki has not been consulted. Lucifer is confident.
strings.saki.incident_3.text:
The Incident requires a classification before a quest can be opened.

This is not true. The quest log insists. The quest log is a spreadsheet Lucifer wrote himself last Tuesday.
strings.saki.incident_4.take_lightly: Take it lightly, which will not last
strings.saki.incident_4.text: The quest log offers a difficulty setting. Every option is the same difficulty. Only the framing changes.
strings.saki.incident_classified.text:
A quest has been generated.

Nobody generated it. It is simply there now, with a title, an icon, a progress bar, and an entirely unreasonable amount of confidence.
strings.saki.incident_evidence_a.text:
The transcript shows Lucifer asking for a story and Saki replying at a completely reasonable speed for a human being. No offense is visible anywhere in the record.

This is the most alarming outcome available.
strings.saki.incident_evidence_b.text:
The transcript shows two friends talking. Lucifer reads it four times looking for a wound.

The absence of one does not slow him down in the slightest.
strings.saki.incident_review_event.text: The record is consulted. It is unhelpful in two distinct ways.
strings.saki.infra_1.infra_back: Return to the quest, now with tooling
strings.saki.infra_1.infra_more: Add a second service, because the first one looked lonely
strings.saki.infra_1.text:
You build infrastructure.

It is not clear what the infrastructure is for. It has a schema. It validates. It has ninety-eight percent test coverage. It has never met Saki and would not recognise him in a queue.
strings.saki.infra_2.carry_on: Go to Saki anyway, carrying repositories
strings.saki.infra_2.commit_fully: Commit to the infrastructure. Fully. Permanently.
strings.saki.infra_2.text:
Three new repositories now exist. One holds the campaign. One holds the tooling that builds the campaign. One documents the tooling.

None of them contain an apology.
strings.saki.meta_1.meta_accept: Acknowledge the arithmetic and keep going
strings.saki.meta_1.meta_defend: Argue that the four sentences would have been worse
strings.saki.meta_1.text:
At this point Lucifer could have sent Saki a four-sentence message. Development time: approximately ninety seconds.

Instead, you are here. So is a validation gate, a determinism guard, and a test that plays this to completion in under a second.
strings.saki.meta_2.philosophy: Determine whether redemption is a social construct
strings.saki.meta_2.ship: Ship it and go find Saki
strings.saki.meta_2.text:
The build is green. Every gate passes. Type checking, linting, the determinism harness, all of it.

Nothing in the pipeline is capable of asking whether this should exist.
strings.saki.meta_delete_node.text:
You select the folder. Your hand hovers. The folder contains sixty-one nodes, eight endings, and a joke about a marble statue that you are quite proud of.

You do not delete it. You were never going to delete it.
strings.saki.meta_event.text: The fourth wall is load-bearing here, and has begun making a noise.
strings.saki.meta_note_a.text:
Twenty-four hours earlier, this was a conversation.

It now has schema validation.
strings.saki.meta_note_b.text:
Most friendships accumulate memories.

This one apparently accumulates deployable content.
strings.saki.philosophy_node.abandon: Abandon cosmology and go find your friend
strings.saki.philosophy_node.text:
Alan Watts is invoked. The conclusion is that the self seeking forgiveness and the self requiring it are the same wave in the same ocean, that guilt is a costume, and that redemption was never a thing one person could grant another.

Saki has been asleep for the entire argument.
strings.saki.prologue.ask_again: Ask again, patiently, like a normal person
strings.saki.prologue.invent_one: Announce that you will simply invent one yourself
strings.saki.prologue.read_changelog: Read the changelog first, for no reason anyone can defend
strings.saki.prologue.send_a_message: Close the laptop and send Saki four sentences
strings.saki.prologue.text:
It began, as most catastrophes do, with a perfectly ordinary conversation.

Lucifer asked Saki for a story — something he liked, something that might become game content. Saki, being a person with a life and no obligation to supply entertainment on demand, did not immediately produce one.

This was Saki's first mistake. Not because Saki had done anything wrong. Because Lucifer now had infrastructure.
strings.saki.reflection_event.text: Reflection produces a result. Reflection was never asked what kind of result.
strings.saki.reflection_result_a.text:
The finding is that Lucifer talks a great deal and occasionally forgets to leave a gap.

This is true, unremarkable, and would have taken one sentence to say out loud.
strings.saki.reflection_result_b.text: The finding is that Saki is a good friend, and that this is an extremely elaborate way of noticing it.
strings.saki.restraint_result.text: The minute passes. Somewhere, quietly, it is recorded.
strings.saki.saki_1.lead_with_apology_fail: You never actually wrote one. Five acts, and no apology.
strings.saki.saki_1.say_nothing: Say nothing and let it load
strings.saki.saki_1.text:
Saki opens the link. The title reads 'Saki: Quest for Redemption.' Beneath it: a play button, a content notice, a version number, and eight achievement slots.

Mercifully, this particular historical record was never released to the general public.
strings.saki.saki_direct.end_here: End it here, with the friendship intact and no deliverable
strings.saki.saki_direct.relapse: Agree warmly, then quietly open the campaign file
strings.saki.saki_direct.text:
You talk to Saki. It takes four minutes. Nothing is on fire. Nothing ever was.

Somewhere in it he mentions, without weight, that he would have read a story if you had just written him one.
strings.saki.saki_direct.write_the_story: Write him the story. No engine. No schema. Just the story.
strings.saki.saki_event.text: Saki reads. The pause is not long, but it is structurally significant.
strings.saki.saki_judgment.judge_recursive: Note his one objection, and open a new file
strings.saki.saki_judgment.judge_redeemed_fail: Redemption is a state, not a button. The state is not met.
strings.saki.saki_judgment.judge_scope: Explain that this could easily be a series
strings.saki.saki_judgment.judge_unresolved: Say nothing and close the laptop
strings.saki.saki_judgment.text:
Saki considers the trials. The branching narrative. The deterministic state machine. The automated deployment pipeline. The philosophical implications. The marble statue line, which he has not reached yet.

Judgment is rendered.
strings.saki.saki_reaction_a.text:
'You actually made a game out of this?'

It is not an accusation. It is closer to a diagnosis.
strings.saki.saki_reaction_b.text:
'Why does it have achievements?'

There is no good answer to this. There is a technically correct one, which is considerably worse.
strings.saki.speedrun_warning.speedrun_reconside: Delete it. Surely this deserves a proper quest.
strings.saki.speedrun_warning.speedrun_send: Send it. Be a normal adult.
strings.saki.speedrun_warning.text:
You type four sentences. Development time: approximately ninety seconds.

The narrator, who had prepared five acts, a tribunal, eight endings and a deterministic state machine, says nothing. The silence is enormous.
strings.saki.trial_apology_1.apology_campaign: Skip the apology and build an entire interactive campaign instead
strings.saki.trial_apology_1.apology_formal: Overly formal, with a reference number
strings.saki.trial_apology_1.apology_rpg: As RPG dialogue, with three response options for Saki
strings.saki.trial_apology_1.text:
TRIAL OF THE APOLOGY

An apology must be constructed.

'Constructed' is the word being used, and nobody has objected to it yet.
strings.saki.trial_gift_1.gift_drink: A drink, in person, with no agenda
strings.saki.trial_gift_1.gift_repo: A private repository, with a README and a licence
strings.saki.trial_gift_1.gift_story: The story he asked for, finally written
strings.saki.trial_gift_1.text:
TRIAL OF THE GIFT

Custom requires an offering. Lucifer considers what Saki would actually want.

This is the first time today that question has been asked.
strings.saki.trial_reflection_1.reflect_ask_ai: Ask an AI to reflect on your behalf
strings.saki.trial_reflection_1.text:
TRIAL OF REFLECTION

Lucifer must reflect upon his actions. A quiet room is provided. The quiet lasts eleven seconds.
strings.saki.trial_restraint_1.restraint_fail: Open the campaign file to check one small thing
strings.saki.trial_restraint_1.restraint_philoso: Consider whether doing nothing is itself an action
strings.saki.trial_restraint_1.text:
TRIAL OF RESTRAINT

This trial only appears to players who have overthought enough to require it. Passing it means doing nothing at all for one full minute.
strings.saki.trials_hub.text:
ACT III — THE TRIALS OF REDEMPTION

Three trials now stand between Lucifer and forgiveness for a thing that may not have happened.
strings.saki.trials_hub.trial_restraint: The Trial of Restraint, which is already going badly
strings.saki.trials_hub.trials_abandon: Abandon the trials; they were self-imposed anyway
strings.saki.trials_hub.trials_done_fail: The quest log declines. You have not yet suffered procedurally.
strings.saki.tribunal_agent.ask_short: Ask for the shortest possible version
strings.saki.tribunal_agent.text:
An AI agent is consulted. It returns a plan with five acts, eight endings, a state schema and a validation gate.

It is a very good plan. That is the problem.
strings.saki.tribunal_bureaucrat.ask_consent: Ask where the consent field is
strings.saki.tribunal_bureaucrat.text:
The Imaginary Bureaucrat requires Form R-1, Request to Be Forgiven, countersigned by the offended party.

The offended party has not yet been informed that he is the offended party.
strings.saki.tribunal_conscience.conscience_acce: Accept that there may be no offense
strings.saki.tribunal_conscience.conscience_reje: Reject the finding on procedural grounds
strings.saki.tribunal_conscience.text:
Conscience arrives, reviews the file, and observes that the offense may not exist.

Conscience is thanked for its time and asked to leave for being unhelpful.
strings.saki.tribunal_full_bench.adjourn: Adjourn the bench and go talk to Saki
strings.saki.tribunal_full_bench.minute_it: Minute the unanimous finding and ignore it
strings.saki.tribunal_full_bench.text:
All seven authorities sit at once. They disagree on everything except a single point, which they state in unison and which Lucifer has now heard four times.

Common Sense looks tired.
strings.saki.tribunal_god.text: God is consulted. God points out that the entire apparatus was assembled in roughly a day, and asks — genuinely curious, no judgement in it — what Lucifer would have produced with a week.
strings.saki.tribunal_hub.consult_god: Consult God, who is awake and mildly interested
strings.saki.tribunal_hub.consult_questlog: Consult a completely inappropriate RPG quest log
strings.saki.tribunal_hub.full_bench: Convene the full bench, which has never been done and should not be
strings.saki.tribunal_hub.text:
Seven authorities are available for consultation.

None of them are Saki. Saki is asleep and has no idea any of this is happening.
strings.saki.tribunal_questlog.text:
The quest log is consulted, which is like asking a spreadsheet for closure. It reports: 'REDEMPTION 0/1. Objective unclear. Marker placed.'

The marker has been placed on Saki's house. Saki's house has never been part of this.
strings.saki.tribunal_self.text:
Lucifer consults Lucifer.

This produces immediate unanimous agreement and no new information whatsoever.
strings.saki.tribunal_verdict.text:
VERDICT: redemption requires trials.

The tribunal cannot say why. The tribunal is, at this point, four abstractions and a spreadsheet.
